# TextOutline

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct TextOutline(Color Color, float Width, TextCorners Corners = TextCorners.Sharp, float MiterLimit = 4, float Softness = 0)
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md), [`TextCorners`](TextCorners.md)

An outline around text, drawn behind its face.

## Remarks

Text can have several, one round another ([`TextEffects.Outlines`](TextEffects.md#outlines)): a dark line round the letters, a wider band of another color round that, and each moved down a little ([`Offset`](#offset)) as the depth under it.

### MiterLimit

```csharp
public float MiterLimit { get; init; }
```

For [`TextCorners.Sharp`](TextCorners.md#sharp) corners, how many times the width a corner may extend before it's cut back, as SVG's `stroke-miterlimit`; `float.PositiveInfinity` never cuts them.

### Offset

```csharp
public Vector2 Offset { get; init; }
```

Gets where the outline is drawn relative to the text, in pixels of the font's native size: moved down, an outline is the depth under the text or under another outline.

### Softness

```csharp
public float Softness { get; init; }
```

How much wider than a screen pixel the outline's edge fades, in pixels of the font's native size.

### Width

```csharp
public float Width { get; init; }
```

How far the outline extends beyond the face's edges, in pixels of the font's native size.
